summary: Diagram (V3): a viewer for flows and hierarchies on lib/graph. HTML nodes over SVG edges under one transform on a DotPattern ground; layered, tree and radial layouts or your own positions, with a size hint so server markup lays out; Diagram.Group draws round its members and collapses to one node that carries their edges; Diagram.Controls, Minimap and Legend. Keyboard: arrows move to the nearest node in that direction, Tab walks a node's relations, Enter selects or follows, Space opens and closes a group, Escape clears; a visually hidden adjacency list names every relation. Edge labels, inferred edges muted at hairline and called inferred in words, and a highlighted path that dims the rest. The selected node's description takes primary ink, since muted ink fell to under 4.5:1 on a pale brand's selected fill.
